about: The claims ledger (docs/knowledge.md): each fact behind a verified knowledge entry, with the page and the exact words that support it. The fact-checker fills in verdict after opening the page itself; the weekly link check re-opens every page.

claims.claim: Short of magnesium shows as yellowing between the veins.
claims.quote: Yellowing between the leaf veins, sometimes with reddish brown tints

claims.claim: Heavy high-potash feeding can bring on magnesium shortage.
claims.quote: as plants take up potassium in preference to magnesium

claims.claim: Short of potassium shows as browning that starts at the edges of older leaves.
claims.quote: Yellow or purple-red leaf tints with browning that begins at the edges of mature leaves

claims.claim: Too much nitrogen gives lots of leaves and less fruit.
claims.quote: Excessive nitrogen causes fruiting plants to produce relatively more foliage, reducing their fruit production

claims.claim: Too much fertiliser browns leaf tips and edges.
claims.quote: Overfertilization can cause leaves to turn brown, gray, dark green, or yellow at margins and tips or overall
